'''Mattac''' was an outlaw [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who grew up on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and eventually took a job with a local [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. After escaping an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]
[[Prison/Legends|prison]], Mattac established an illegal [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-refitting operation in [[Brenn]].
